title: The Mole
role.loyalGoal: Complete missions and find the traitors. Trust no one!
role.traitorGoal: Sabotage missions without getting caught. Shift the suspicion onto others!
role.alone: You're on your own – good luck!
intro.text: There are {n} secret traitors among you. Each round someone picks a team for a mission – traitors can secretly sabotage it. Then you discuss and vote someone out.
intro.loyalHow: … when all traitors are voted out or {n} missions succeed.
intro.traitorHow: … when {n} missions are sabotaged or they make up half of the players.
roles.title: Secretly look at your phone!
roles.text: {n} of you are traitors. Keep a straight face …

mission.phone: What do you do on the mission?
mission.loyalOnly: As a loyal player you can't sabotage.
mission.wait: The team is on a mission …
vote.title: Discuss! Who do you vote out?

vote.afterOk: The mission worked. Still: who's suspicious?
